name: [Part 12] one SGD update equals independent pooled oracle
input: one SGD update equals independent pooled oracle
test:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
x=torch.tensor([[[1.,2.],[5.,7.]],[[2.,-1.],[3.,4.]]],dtype=torch.float64)
lengths=torch.tensor([1,2]); labels=torch.tensor([0,1])
model=torch.nn.Linear(2,2,dtype=torch.float64)
with torch.no_grad():
 model.weight.copy_(torch.tensor([[.2,-.3],[.4,.1]],dtype=torch.float64)); model.bias.copy_(torch.tensor([.1,-.2],dtype=torch.float64))
w0=model.weight.detach().clone(); b0=model.bias.detach().clone()
pooled=torch.tensor([[1.,2.],[2.5,1.5]],dtype=torch.float64)
ref=torch.nn.Linear(2,2,dtype=torch.float64)
with torch.no_grad(): ref.weight.copy_(w0); ref.bias.copy_(b0)
expected_loss=F.cross_entropy(ref(pooled),labels); expected_loss.backward()
expected_w=w0-.1*ref.weight.grad; expected_b=b0-.1*ref.bias.grad
optimizer=torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(),lr=.1)
model.eval()
loss=train_step(model,optimizer,x,lengths,labels)
assert model.training and loss.ndim==0 and not loss.requires_grad and loss.dtype==x.dtype
assert torch.allclose(loss,expected_loss.detach(),atol=1e-12)
assert torch.allclose(model.weight,expected_w,atol=1e-12) and torch.allclose(model.bias,expected_b,atol=1e-12)
assert torch.allclose(model.weight.grad,ref.weight.grad) and torch.allclose(model.bias.grad,ref.bias.grad)
print("ok")

name: [Part 12] repeated steps clear stale gradients
test:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
x=torch.tensor([[[2.,0.]]],dtype=torch.float64); lengths=torch.tensor([1]); labels=torch.tensor([1])
a=torch.nn.Linear(2,2,dtype=torch.float64); b=torch.nn.Linear(2,2,dtype=torch.float64)
with torch.no_grad(): b.load_state_dict(a.state_dict())
oa=torch.optim.SGD(a.parameters(),lr=.05); ob=torch.optim.SGD(b.parameters(),lr=.05)
train_step(a,oa,x,lengths,labels)
for p in a.parameters(): p.grad.fill_(1e5)
train_step(a,oa,x,lengths,labels)
train_step(b,ob,x,lengths,labels); train_step(b,ob,x,lengths,labels)
for pa,pb in zip(a.parameters(),b.parameters()): assert torch.allclose(pa,pb,atol=1e-12)
print("ok")

name: [Part 13] evaluation returns metrics and leaves parameters untouched
input: evaluation returns metrics and leaves parameters untouched
test:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
x=torch.tensor([[[1.,0.],[999.,999.]],[[0.,1.],[2.,2.]]],dtype=torch.float64)
lengths=torch.tensor([1,2]); labels=torch.tensor([0,1])
model=torch.nn.Linear(2,2,dtype=torch.float64)
with torch.no_grad(): model.weight.copy_(torch.eye(2,dtype=torch.float64)); model.bias.zero_()
grad_modes=[]
hook=model.register_forward_pre_hook(lambda module,args: grad_modes.append(torch.is_grad_enabled()))
model.train(); before=[p.detach().clone() for p in model.parameters()]
out=evaluate_batch(model,x,lengths,labels)
expected_logits=torch.tensor([[1.,0.],[1.,1.5]],dtype=torch.float64)
assert grad_modes==[False]
hook.remove()
assert set(out)=={'logits','predictions','loss','accuracy'} and not model.training
assert out['logits'].shape==(2,2) and out['logits'].dtype==x.dtype and not out['logits'].requires_grad
assert torch.allclose(out['logits'],expected_logits)
assert out['predictions'].dtype==torch.long and torch.equal(out['predictions'],torch.tensor([0,1]))
assert out['loss'].ndim==0 and not out['loss'].requires_grad and torch.allclose(out['loss'],F.cross_entropy(expected_logits,labels))
assert type(out['accuracy']) is float and out['accuracy']==1.0
assert all(torch.equal(p,q) for p,q in zip(model.parameters(),before))
print("ok")
